debug_enabled.description: Enable verbose debug logging to syslog or console.

max_clients.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

socket_dir.description: Directory where the PC/SC socket will be created for client communication.

socket_group.description: Unix group that owns the PC/SC socket. Clients in this group can access smart cards without root.

auto_enable.description: Automatically enable readers when they are detected (hot-plug support).

drivers_dir.description: Path to the directory containing reader driver shared libraries.

enable_usb_scanner.description: Enable built-in USB device scanning (may be deprecated or unsupported on some systems).

readers.description: List of custom reader driver configurations (advanced use). Each entry defines a reader and its driver.

name.description: Human-readable name for the reader (used for identification only).

device.description: Device path (e.g., /dev/bus/usb/001/002) or bus:port for the physical reader.

driver.description: Name of the driver library file (e.g., libccid.so, libacr38u.so).

log_file.description: Path to a log file, or 'SysLog' to use systemd journal/syslog.

allow_external_card_rdr.description: Allow non-root users to access external card readers (security-sensitive).
